summary: Iteration 9 — Verified PT/Games removal, new credit spec (Sem1=22cr, Sem2=21.5cr), live server-load trending tracker, Google Drive Viewer link in FileCard, mobile PWA meta tags, GZip middleware, MongoDB indexes, and Admin AddModule filtering. Backend: 21/21 pytest passed. Frontend: All target flows verified. Fixed one minor stale hardcoded Sem2 count (10 -> 9) in NotesHub. Frontend required a manual restart to pick up updated index.html.

ui_bugs.issue: Sem2 card had hardcoded 'count: 10' after PT removal (should be 9). Fixed by testing agent.

action_items: After edits to /app/frontend/public/index.html, the frontend service must be restarted (sudo supervisorctl restart frontend) — hot reload does NOT reload static index.html changes. Testing agent restarted the service to verify iteration 9 meta tags are actually served.

Note: Cloudflare in front of preview URL adds its own content-encoding: gzip on responses. Backend GZipMiddleware(minimum_size=800) IS registered in server.py, but end-to-end verification through Cloudflare returns gzip regardless. This is fine.
Consider future-proofing NotesHub semester counts by deriving from API rather than hardcoding — currently fixed but any subject addition/removal will require another manual constant update.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 577 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into: routes/subjects.py, routes/files.py, routes/analytics.py, auth.py, storage.py.
analytics_trending has no time-window filtering (all-time counts). For a live tracker, a rolling 24h/7d aggregation would be more meaningful.
The Admin.jsx isDirectFilesSubject regex /\b(lab|laboratory)\b/i correctly excludes labs — verified in UI.
seed_if_empty always upserts credits on every startup (idempotent) — good practice for schema evolution.
DEPRECATED_SUBJECTS purge runs on every startup — good defensive cleanup. Verified working.
seed_data_creation: Test uploaded 2 dummy notes files (physics + chemistry) to verify live-tracker increments, then deleted them (soft-delete via is_deleted=true). Subject_stats increments (Physics +3 views, Chemistry +2 downloads) remain in DB — visible in trending chart.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 fully verified. Backend has 21 tests in test_iteration9_changes.py covering: subject count=19, credits per spec, live-tracker real load, gzip encoding, MongoDB indexes, auth regression. Frontend restart was required to serve updated index.html meta tags. NotesHub had a stale hardcoded Sem2 count fixed to 9. All key UI checkpoints validated: syllabus 22/21.5 credits chips, Communication Skill-I 1.5 cr, Workshop 1 cr, no PT anywhere, trending chart with 8 bars + top-6 grid with rank badges, FileCard driveViewerUrl targets docs.google.com/viewer?url=, no /viewer/:fileId route usage, minHeight:40px tap targets, mobile PWA meta tags present, touch-action:manipulation on body, Admin AddModule dropdown filters out labs/PPS/Workshop/NSS/EngGraphics leaving exactly 10 module subjects.
rca_of_issue: Frontend index.html changes are static assets served by CRA dev server — hot reload does NOT re-emit index.html. The initial curl showed only viewport meta but none of the apple-mobile/mobile-web-app tags. After 'sudo supervisorctl restart frontend', all meta tags served correctly. Root cause: hot reload only reprocesses source files under /src, not /public/index.html.
